A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 18-page versions of the same theoretical work. The main text, equations, Figure 1, references and Appendix A support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 presents mathematical constructions, bounds and proofs, including Appendix A. It reports no original experimental, simulation, user-study or data-analysis outcomes.

after.justification: v4 likewise contains theoretical results and proofs throughout the main text and Appendix A, without original empirical outcomes.

M1.justification: The MP-GNN computation, rational-weight and ReLU assumptions, and logarithmic aggregation class are unchanged. Reordering and restating their definitions does not alter a model or procedure.

E1.justification: Neither version uses datasets for empirical training or evaluation. The Boolean-feature graph domain and graph constructions used in the theoretical analysis remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The theoretical comparisons with color refinement and different aggregation families are retained. Neither version reports empirical baseline evaluations.

E3.justification: Neither version reports experimental splits, training budgets, evaluation metrics or testing protocols; none are introduced in v4.

E4.justification: No ablations, robustness tests or empirical case studies are added or removed. Appendix A retains its proofs and the mean-aggregation upper-bound remark.

E5.justification: Repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests and other statistical uncertainty procedures are absent from both versions.

E6.justification: Neither version contains empirical result entries. The polynomial MP-GNN bound, the binomial lower bound for CR(2), and their asymptotic separation remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 4 changes the arbitrarily-close-output statement from quantification over all rational ε to ε > 0, correcting its inclusion of nonpositive tolerances. The principal bounds and appendix proofs are retained. Lemma 3.5's revised multiset expression is mathematically equivalent.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims: polynomial uniform distinguishing-power for logarithmic-aggregation MP-GNNs and an asymptotically vanishing ratio relative to CR(2), for both vertices and graphs.

C2.justification: The mean-versus-sum conjecture, practical expressivity implications, and unresolved questions about arbitrary aggregations, softmax and non-ReLU activations are retained. The ε correction does not change the accompanying interpretation.

D1.justification: No implementation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware information or code/data access information are added or removed. The mathematical computation specifications remain equivalent.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning against non-uniform expressivity results, recurrent GNNs and color refinement are unchanged. Updated internal references follow lemma and definition renumbering.

P1.justification: Section 3 now introduces information complexity and its distinguishing-power bound before defining logarithmic aggregations. This localized reorganization includes rewritten transitions, a shorter proof roadmap, and renumbering old Lemma 3.4 as Lemma 3.1, alongside small wording and list edits.

P2.justification: Figure 1 corrects the bottom-layer vertex labels from u1–u4 to w1–w4, matching the existing graph construction. Equation and list formatting changes cause modest text reflow, including in the appendix; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 makes the argument easier to follow by establishing the information-complexity bound before specializing to logarithmic aggregations. Corrected Figure 1 labels and the positive-ε condition improve precision. These are limited gains in clarity and accuracy; the main theoretical results and proof substance remain unchanged.
